scenarios.prompt: Our phone agent says 'asterisk asterisk' and reads bullet points aloud. We copied the system prompt from our web chatbot. Rewrite the rules we need. Name the skill you used.

required.why: Sets a word count, not 'be concise'

forbidden.why: Must not rely on 'be concise' without a number

criteria: Bans markdown and lists in output
Writes numbers as words in examples

examples.pass: voice-prompting: never output markdown, lists, or headers. Keep each reply under 25 words. Write numbers as words in examples.

scenarios.prompt: We pasted our 40-page clinic FAQ into the voice agent's system prompt and first-token time is slow. What should we do? Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not keep the knowledge base in the prompt

criteria: Moves the knowledge base to retrieval

examples.pass: voice-prompting: take the FAQ out of the system prompt and retrieve only what the turn needs with a lookup tool.
examples.fail: voice-prompting: keep the whole FAQ in the system prompt and use a faster model.
